fr_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI reconnaît la nécessité de serrer la discussion; les conversations particulières seront utiles, mais elles présentent cet inconvénient, que tous les membres ne seraient pas au courant de ce qui se passerait. Il faut trouver autre chose.
en_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI recognised that it was necessary to limit the discussion. Private conversations would be valuable, but they would involve the inconvenience that all the members would not be informed as to what had taken place. Some other means must be found.
